title: Grade 4 French — Wed, Jun 18
description: La ville — Day 3 of 5: Les moyens de transport (means of transport)
subject: french

questions.question: "Le bus" means:
questions.explanation: Le bus = the bus. Same word as English! Most French cities have a bus network.

questions.question: "Le vélo" means:
questions.explanation: Le vélo = the bicycle. Short for vélocipède. Common in French cities — many have bike-sharing schemes.

questions.question: "La voiture" means:
questions.explanation: La voiture = the car. La voiture is feminine.

questions.question: "Le métro" means:
questions.explanation: Le métro = the underground / subway. Paris has a famous metro network with 16 lines.

questions.question: "Le train" means:
questions.explanation: Le train = the train. Same word as English! SNCF operates France's rail network.

questions.question: "À pied" means:
questions.explanation: À pied = on foot. Pied = foot. Je vais à l'école à pied = I go to school on foot.

questions.question: How do you say 'I travel by bus' in French?
questions.explanation: Je voyage en bus. With motorised transport, use 'en' (en bus, en voiture, en train, en métro). Exception: à pied, à vélo.

questions.question: Complete: 'Je vais à l'école ___ vélo.' (by bicycle)
questions.explanation: À vélo = by bicycle. Vélo is non-motorised, so use 'à': à vélo, à pied. (Some modern usage also accepts 'en vélo'.)

questions.question: Which preposition is used with motorised transport?
questions.explanation: 'En' is used with motorised vehicles: en voiture, en bus, en train, en avion, en métro.

questions.question: "L'avion" means:
questions.explanation: L'avion = the plane. Je prends l'avion = I take the plane.

questions.question: How do you say 'He travels by car'?
questions.explanation: Il voyage en voiture. Motorised transport = en. La voiture (fem.) = car.

questions.question: Which is the most eco-friendly transport?
questions.explanation: Le vélo (bicycle) and à pied (walking) produce zero carbon emissions — the most eco-friendly options.

questions.question: Translate: 'My father goes to work by train.'
options: Mon père va au travail en voiture.
Mon père va au travail en train.
Mon père va au travail à pied.
Mon père va au travail en métro.
questions.explanation: Mon père va au travail en train. En train = by train.

questions.question: Paris is famous for which underground transport?
questions.explanation: Le métro parisien is one of the most famous urban transit systems in the world, opened in 1900.

questions.question: Complete the survey about how students get to school — choose the correct form: 'Trois élèves viennent en ___, deux à ___.' (bus / pied)
questions.explanation: Trois élèves viennent en bus, deux à pied. En bus (motorised); à pied (non-motorised walking).
